title: Decker, a platform that builds on the legacy of Hypercard and classic macOS
summary: Decker is a multimedia authoring platform that revives the spirit of Apple's Hypercard, allowing users to create interactive card-based applications using a custom declarative language (DML) with embedded HTML/CSS/JavaScript, combining retro computing aesthetics with modern web technologies.
problem_solved: Makes interactive multimedia application development accessible to non-programmers while providing a rapid prototyping environment that honors the creative simplicity of Hypercard.
why_valuable: Preserves and modernizes the Hypercard philosophy of democratizing software creation, offering a unique platform for quick prototyping, educational use, and nostalgic yet functional creative development.
